example_sentences_in_bangla: সরকারি দপ্তর থেকে তাকে ইত্তিলা পাঠানো হয়েছে।
দুনিয়ার মালিক দীনকে ইত্তিলা পাঠিয়েছে, যা মৃত্যুর ইঙ্গিত।
example_sentences_in_english: A notice has been sent to him from the government office.
The Lord of the worlds has sent a summons to the poor, indicating death.
history: This expression often appears in religious or literary contexts in Bengali culture, symbolizing a divine call or death notice, as in the example referencing God's summons to the destitute.
note: Derived from Persian/Arabic 'ittila', commonly used in formal and spiritual Bengali discourse.
